translate.label: Translate
translate.subject: Translate widget: every tap shows itself. The Type in English pill, each line, each line's speaker, the black under the lines and the card's edge ripple when pressed (RemoteViews run no code on a press, so the ripple is each view's background); the list's own grey selector is off so it never flashes over a line; the root is @android:id/background, so on Android 12+ the app opened from the widget grows out of it. A test reads every setOnClick* id from the widget's Java and fails any without a ripple; 5 mutants red, javacheck 29/29. Asked: "add an animation when clicking on anything in the widget translator app".

reddit.label: Reddit Snoo
reddit.subject: Reddit Snoo: a new icon, and pulling to refresh shows it. The icon is a minimal white mark on Reddit orange: a round head with two eyes and an antenna, our own drawing in the look of Reddit's icon. Pulling down at the top of a list now brings that mark down under the chips, growing and turning upright with the finger; it pops once at the point where letting go reloads and hops while Reddit answers, in place of the thin line. 244 e2e checks pass; without the mark's growth the pull check goes red. Asked: "No use the real reddit icon but minimalist", "when reloading like dragging from the top bottom, it should show a logo instead of just a line to be clear".

morphe.label: YouTube+
morphe.subject: YouTube+ Manager: opening it shows the details instead of jumping into YouTube, with Check for updates that makes the Pi look for new Morphe patches now. One card, a line each for YouTube (its version), Morphe patches (the tag in the installed YouTube, "New: v2.4.0" when the Pi has newer), Google sign-in and the Manager itself (Version N, its own Update when one would ask), and "Checked N minutes ago" = when the Pi last looked. Check for updates posts /look to the Pi (once a minute at most), morphe-build.path starts build.mjs at once instead of at the next 3-hourly look, the phone waits for that look to end (version.json now says looking / looked) and puts in what it made; it also asks the Manager's own updater. Open YouTube stays as a button; the family opens YouTube from the home-screen shortcut. e2e (details, check, busy, failure, self update, every opening stays; 6 mutants red), Pi tests 20 (throttle + looking/looked, 2 mutants red), javacheck 10 files + 7 tests. Asked: "opening youtube+ manager should show detail not just redirect so can check for updates for stuff like morphe too".
